versions.description_html:
Your slowest report has a fix, and its name is Azure Synapse. It's Microsoft's service for holding a company's data warehouse and its big data under one roof.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • The Report That Used to Open in Seconds
  • What Azure Synapse Actually Is
  • The Engines Under One Roof
  • A Tiny Example That Makes It Click
  • Why Teams Actually Get Excited About It
  • Where It Fits Next to Power BI and Microsoft 365
  • What It Actually Costs, Honestly
  • The Mistakes That Cost Beginners the Most
  • Is It Still Worth Learning in 2026
  • The Short Recap and One Question for You

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.
